mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, week_start, status, started_at, submitted_at, undone_at, elapsed_seconds, no_other_risk, review_json, created_at, updated_at FROM catchup_session WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}

SELECT id, workspace_id, user_id, week_start, status, started_at, submitted_at, undone_at, elapsed_seconds, no_other_risk, review_json, created_at, updated_at FROM catchup_session WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND week_start = #{weekStart} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catchup_session (id, workspace_id, user_id, week_start, status, no_other_risk) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{weekStart}, #{status}, #{noOtherRisk})
mapper.update: UPDATE catchup_session SET status = #{status}, started_at = #{startedAt}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, undone_at = #{undoneAt}, elapsed_seconds = #{elapsedSeconds}, no_other_risk = #{noOtherRisk}, review_json = #{reviewJson} WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

sql.if: AND (t.req_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none'))

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title, t.item_type, t.item_no, t.board_column, t.req_id, r.name AS req_name, t.due_date, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.is_blocked AS blocked, t.blocked_reason, t.owner_user_id FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( t.owner_user_id = #{userId}
OR (t.owner_user_id IS NULL AND t.owner = #{displayName})
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.user_id = #{userId} AND tl.started_at >= #{from} AND tl.started_at < #{to}) ) AND ( (t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{to}) OR (t.updated_at >= #{from} AND t.updated_at < #{to}) OR (t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{to}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.user_id = #{userId} AND tl.started_at >= #{from} AND tl.started_at < #{to}) )
ORDER BY (t.completed_at IS NULL), t.completed_at DESC, t.updated_at DESC LIMIT 80
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catchup_decision (session_id, draft_key, kind, action, answer, title, payload_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{draftKey}, #{kind}, #{action}, #{answer}, #{title}, #{payloadJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kind = VALUES(kind), action = VALUES(action), answer = VALUES(answer), title = VALUES(title), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM catchup_decision WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND draft_key = #{draftKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catchup_time_alloc (session_id, row_key, day, req_id, minutes) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{rowKey}, #{day}, #{reqId}, #{minutes})
INSERT INTO task_log (task_id, workspace_id, actor_id, action, detail, change_data) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{workspaceId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{changeData})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catchup_write (session_id, write_type, ref_id, prev_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{writeType}, #{refId}, #{prevJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, write_type, ref_id, prev_json, created_at FROM catchup_write WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT req_id FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catchup_carry (from_session_id, to_week_start, task_id, item_no, title, project_name, type_label, status_label, minutes, reason) VALUES (#{fromSessionId}, #{toWeekStart}, #{taskId}, #{itemNo}, #{title}, #{projectName}, #{typeLabel}, #{statusLabel}, #{minutes}, #{reason})
